name: Diabetes+Metformin+HbA1c cohort
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Diabetes' MATCH (p)-[:PRESCRIBED]->(d:DrugExposure) WHERE d.drug_name CONTAINS 'Metformin' MATCH (p)-[:MEASURED]->(m:Measurement) WHERE m.description CONTAINS 'Hemoglobin A1c' RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS patients

name: Inpatient condition care pathway
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:ConditionOccurrence)-[:DURING_VISIT]->(v:Visit) WHERE v.encounter_class = 'inpatient' RETURN c.condition_concept AS condition, count(DISTINCT p) AS patients, count(v) AS inpatient_visits ORDER BY patients DESC LIMIT 20

name: Drug prescribed for diagnosed condition
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Diabetes' MATCH (p)-[:PRESCRIBED]->(d:DrugExposure) WHERE d.start_date >= c.start_date AND d.reason CONTAINS 'Diabetes' RETURN d.drug_name AS drug, count(DISTINCT p) AS patients ORDER BY patients DESC LIMIT 15

name: Top conditions by patient count
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c.condition_concept IS NOT NULL RETURN c.condition_concept AS condition, count(DISTINCT p) AS patient_count ORDER BY patient_count DESC LIMIT 25

name: Diabetes-hypertension-CKD triple comorbidity
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c1:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c1.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Diabetes' MATCH (p)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c2:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c2.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Hypertension' MATCH (p)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c3:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c3.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Chronic kidney disease' RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS triple_comorbid_patients

name: Global co-prescription drug pairs
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRESCRIBED]->(d1:DrugExposure) MATCH (p)-[:PRESCRIBED]->(d2:DrugExposure) WHERE d1.drug_name < d2.drug_name RETURN d1.drug_name AS drug_a, d2.drug_name AS drug_b, count(DISTINCT p) AS co_prescribed_patients ORDER BY co_prescribed_patients DESC LIMIT 25

name: Uncontrolled diabetics by lab value
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Diabetes' MATCH (p)-[:MEASURED]->(m:Measurement) WHERE m.description CONTAINS 'Hemoglobin A1c' AND m.value > 7.0 RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS uncontrolled_diabetics, avg(m.value) AS avg_hba1c

name: Treatment started after diagnosis
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE c.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Hypertension' MATCH (p)-[:PRESCRIBED]->(d:DrugExposure) WHERE d.start_date > c.start_date RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS treated_after_diagnosis, count(d) AS post_diagnosis_scripts

name: Diabetes trials by phase
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(c:Condition) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' RETURN t.phase AS phase, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC

name: Drug interventions by trial count
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(c:Condition) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' MATCH (t)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) WHERE i.type = 'DRUG' RETURN i.name AS intervention, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 20

name: Industry phase-3 diabetes sponsors
cypher: MATCH (s:Sponsor)<-[:SPONSORED_BY]-(t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(c:Condition) WHERE s.class = 'INDUSTRY' AND t.phase CONTAINS '3' AND c.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' RETURN s.name AS sponsor, count(DISTINCT t) AS phase3_trials ORDER BY phase3_trials DESC LIMIT 20

name: Arm-intervention-drug pathway
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(c:Condition) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' MATCH (t)-[:HAS_ARM]->(a:ArmGroup)-[:USES]->(i:Intervention)-[:CODED_AS_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN d.name AS drug, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials, count(DISTINCT a) AS arms ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 20

name: Terminated trials with adverse events
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) WHERE t.why_stopped IS NOT NULL RETURN t.nct_id AS trial, t.why_stopped AS reason, count(DISTINCT ae) AS adverse_events ORDER BY adverse_events DESC LIMIT 20

name: Most-studied conditions globally
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(c:Condition) RETURN c.name AS condition, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 30

name: EMR condition prevalence vs trial coverage
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(co:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE co.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Diabetes' WITH count(DISTINCT p) AS emr_patients MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(c:Condition) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' RETURN emr_patients, count(DISTINCT t) AS diabetes_trials

name: Trial drugs by PubMed evidence
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:REFERENCED_IN]->(t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(c:Condition) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' MATCH (t)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) WHERE i.type = 'DRUG' RETURN i.name AS drug, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials, count(DISTINCT a) AS articles ORDER BY articles DESC LIMIT 20

name: Patient drug exposure vs FAERS events
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRESCRIBED]->(de:DrugExposure) WHERE de.drug_name CONTAINS 'Metformin' WITH count(DISTINCT p) AS exposed_patients MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT]->(ae:AdverseEvent) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'Metformin' RETURN exposed_patients, ae.term AS adverse_event, ae.count AS faers_reports ORDER BY faers_reports DESC LIMIT 20

name: EMR condition to trial drug to FAERS chain
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(co:ConditionOccurrence) WHERE co.condition_concept CONTAINS 'Diabetes' WITH count(DISTINCT p) AS emr_patients MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(c:Condition) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' MATCH (t)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention)-[:CODED_AS_DRUG]->(td:Drug) MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT]->(ae:AdverseEvent) WHERE d.name = td.name RETURN td.name AS drug, emr_patients, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials, count(DISTINCT ae) AS known_adverse_events ORDER BY known_adverse_events DESC LIMIT 20

name: Trials to PubMed MeSH co-occurrence
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(c:Condition) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' MATCH (a:Article)-[:REFERENCED_IN]->(t) MATCH (a)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m:MeSHTerm) RETURN m.name AS mesh_term, count(DISTINCT a) AS articles ORDER BY articles DESC LIMIT 25

name: EMR drug to trial to PubMed evidence
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRESCRIBED]->(de:DrugExposure) WHERE de.drug_name CONTAINS 'Metformin' WITH count(DISTINCT p) AS exposed_patients MATCH (a:Article)-[:REFERENCED_IN]->(t:ClinicalTrial)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) WHERE i.name CONTAINS 'Metformin' RETURN exposed_patients, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials, count(DISTINCT a) AS articles
